title: Monitoring and incidents
objectives: Alert on what users notice: failed and stale data
Find each job's latest run and last success
Respond to an incident in a set order

exercises.prompt: It's 12:00 on 2 November 2026. Alert on each job whose latest run failed ('failed') or whose last success is more than 24 hours old ('stale'). Return job and reason, in job order.
hints: The starter lists jobs that ever failed. load_stock failed last; build_gold never failed but hasn't succeeded since yesterday morning.
Find each job's latest run with row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY job ORDER BY started_at DESC), and its last success with max(started_at) WHERE status = 'succeeded'.
Latest failed is 'failed'; otherwise a last success before 2026-11-01 12:00 is 'stale'.
